headline: Apple CarPlay expands to pontoon boats with on-water navigation
summary: Apple's in-car interface, CarPlay, is officially expanding beyond automobiles to include select pontoon boats, offering dedicated on-water navigation.
details: Apple CarPlay is set to move beyond traditional vehicles and onto the water, with its interface soon appearing on select pontoon boats. This marks a significant expansion for the popular in-car system.

Boat manufacturers Crest and Balise are among the first brands to integrate Apple CarPlay into the helm of their pontoon models. This integration will provide boaters with a familiar and intuitive interface for their on-water activities.

The system will offer specialized on-water navigation capabilities, allowing users to access maps and routing tailored for marine environments. This brings a new level of connectivity and convenience to boating.

headline_marked: SpaceX's first earnings call reveals [[AI compute deals drive billions in revenue]]
headline: SpaceX's first earnings call reveals AI compute deals drive billions in revenue
summary: SpaceX's first public earnings call highlighted significant revenue from AI compute deals with Anthropic and Google, alongside ambitious projections for Starlink's global internet dominance.
details: SpaceX's first public earnings call revealed billions in new revenue from its AI compute business, driven by deals with companies like Anthropic and Google. This new segment has become a significant financial contributor, alongside its core space and Starlink operations.

CEO Elon Musk projected Starlink will deliver a majority of the world's internet in under 10 years. Executives offered more tempered claims, stating Starlink will represent a significant portion of global internet traffic.

CFO Bret Johnsen highlighted $6.7 billion in additional cloud services revenue contracted over a six-month period, starting October. He projected a $100 billion annualized revenue run rate (ARR) by the end of this year, based on December's expected revenue.

Musk subsequently stated that the $100 billion ARR was a certainty and likely to be higher. He also moved up the company's internal projection for reaching a trillion dollars in total revenue from 2031 to 2030.
